in_sanskrit.name: ध्रोण
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The name Dhron is derived from the Sanskrit word ध्रुवत्वम् (dhruvatvam), which means steadfastness, firmness, and reliability. This name is often given to children who are believed to possess these qualities and are expected to uphold them throughout their lives.

in_hindi.name: ध्रोन
in_hindi.long_meaning: The name Dhron in Hindi is derived from the Sanskrit word ध्रुवता (dhruvata), which means steadfast and reliable.

in_tamil.name: திருந்
in_tamil.long_meaning: The name Dhron in Tamil is derived from the Tamil words திரு (thiru) and ந (n), which mean sacred, divine, and child, respectively. While the name Dhron is not directly derived from Sanskrit, it shares similar meanings with the Sanskrit word ध्रुवत्वम् (dhruvatvam).

in_telugu.name: ధ్రోన
in_telugu.long_meaning: The name Dhron in Telugu is derived from the Sanskrit word ధ్రూపత్వం (dhruvatvam), which means steadfastness, firmness, and reliability.

in_marathi.name: Dhron
in_marathi.long_meaning: Dhron हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Dhron is a Sanskrit name derived from the root word ‘dhr’ which means ‘to hold, sustain, or support’. The name Dhron signifies a mighty and powerful individual, one who holds and sustains the universe. In Hindu mythology, Dhron is an epithet of the god Indra, the god of rain, thunderbolts, and power.
